name: RouteLoom Connection Report
subtitle: Compare connection failures
description:
RouteLoom gives you a clearer connection incident report by checking a reference endpoint and a work endpoint together.

• See whether failures affect your work service, your reference service or both
• Record HTTP responses and transport errors with timestamps and request durations
• Follow incidents from a healthy pair through observed failure and recovery
• Keep sleep and shutdown gaps separate from observed failure spans
• Preview a support report with hostnames while omitting paths and query strings
• Compare recent sessions with earlier observations saved on this Mac
• Open the current incident with a configurable global keyboard shortcut
• Explore timeout, offline and TLS failure cases in Sample mode without network requests

Configure one named pair of HTTPS endpoints before starting. Nothing runs on first launch. Both endpoints receive HEAD requests during an active session. Standard certificate validation remains enabled. Redirects are not followed. Some servers reject HEAD requests, so use endpoints that support this method. An HTTP error confirms a response was received but does not mean the service is healthy.

Paired observations offer possible leads for support. They do not establish an ISP, DNS or VPN cause and do not measure continuous uptime. RouteLoom does not run checks while your Mac sleeps. The menu bar always shows when a session is stopped.

History stays local. RouteLoom has no account, telemetry, analytics or developer backend. Endpoint servers see requests and your source IP. Reports are copied only when you choose Copy report after viewing the preview. Clear local history and endpoint settings at any time. Launch at login is optional and off by default. English and Spanish interfaces and reports are included.

All features are included with your purchase. No subscription or in app purchases.


Open the panel with Control Option R.

promotional_text: Compare a reference endpoint with a work endpoint during the same incident. Tell a shared failure from a target only failure and copy a support ready report.
